prompts.sql: SELECT CONCAT(section_name, Pair_Number_NS, '-NS - ', Player_Name_N, ' - ', Player_Name_S) AS Pair_NS, COUNT(Score_NS) AS Count, COUNT(CASE WHEN Score_NS>=Par_NS THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Count_GE, AVG(Pct_NS) AS Pct, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Score_NS>Par_NS THEN Board END, ', ') AS Boards_GT, COUNT(CASE WHEN Score_NS=Par_NS THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Count_EQ, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Score_NS=Par_NS THEN Board END, ', ') AS Boards_EQ, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN Score_NS < Par_NS THEN Board END, ', ') AS Boards_LT FROM self GROUP BY Pair_NS ORDER BY Count_GE DESC, Count_EQ

Our_Opening_Leads.title: Our Opening Leads
Our_Opening_Leads.help: **Showing the opening leads {player1_name} and {player2_name} made. SD_Lead_Cost is the tricks the lead gave up, on average over sampled layouts, against the best lead from the leader's own hand (single dummy (SD)); SD_Lead_Best_Card is that lead and SD_Lead_Rank where ours ranked. DD_Lead_Cost compares with the best lead seeing all four hands (double dummy (DD)). Set_Pct is how often the lead beats the contract. Field columns show how the other tables did on the same board.**

prompts.prompt: Show board, contract, leader, lead, SD lead cost, SD best card, SD rank, set pct, DD lead cost, whether the lead was DD best, field averages, tricks, DD tricks, pct. Show those boards we defended. Sort by SD lead cost descending.
prompts.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT *, AVG(SD_Lead_Cost) OVER (PARTITION BY Board) AS Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, AVG(CAST(Lead_Is_DD_Best AS INT)) OVER (PARTITION BY Board) AS Field_DD_Best_Pct FROM self) SELECT Board, Contract, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, Lead, ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS SD_Lead_Cost, SD_Lead_Best_Card, SD_Lead_Rank, ROUND(SD_Lead_Set_Pct::DOUBLE, 2) AS Set_Pct, DD_Lead_Cost, Lead_Is_DD_Best, ROUND(Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, 2) AS Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(Field_DD_Best_Pct, 2) AS Field_DD_Best_Pct, Tricks, DD_Tricks, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM f WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True ORDER BY SD_Lead_Cost DESC NULLS LAST, DD_Lead_Cost DESC NULLS LAST, Board

fr.title: Nos entames
fr.help: **Entames de {player1_name} et {player2_name}. SD_Lead_Cost : levées perdues en moyenne, sur des donnes simulées, par rapport à la meilleure entame vue de la main de l'entameur (simple mort (SD)) ; SD_Lead_Best_Card est cette entame et SD_Lead_Rank le rang de la nôtre. DD_Lead_Cost compare avec la meilleure entame en voyant les quatre mains (double mort (DD)). Set_Pct : fréquence à laquelle l'entame fait chuter le contrat. Les colonnes Field montrent les autres tables sur la même donne.**

Our_Costly_Leads.title: Our Leads That Cost Tricks
Our_Costly_Leads.help: **Showing our opening leads that gave up at least a quarter of a trick on average against the best single dummy (SD) lead from the leader's own hand. DD_Lead_Cost shows what the lead cost on the actual layout.**

prompts.prompt: Show board, contract, leader, lead, SD lead cost, SD best card, SD rank, set pct, DD lead cost, field averages, tricks, DD tricks, pct. Show those boards we defended and SD lead cost >= 0.25.
prompts.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT *, AVG(SD_Lead_Cost) OVER (PARTITION BY Board) AS Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, AVG(CAST(Lead_Is_DD_Best AS INT)) OVER (PARTITION BY Board) AS Field_DD_Best_Pct FROM self) SELECT Board, Contract, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, Lead, ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS SD_Lead_Cost, SD_Lead_Best_Card, SD_Lead_Rank, ROUND(SD_Lead_Set_Pct::DOUBLE, 2) AS Set_Pct, DD_Lead_Cost, Lead_Is_DD_Best, ROUND(Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, 2) AS Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(Field_DD_Best_Pct, 2) AS Field_DD_Best_Pct, Tricks, DD_Tricks, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM f WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True AND ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.25 ORDER BY SD_Lead_Cost DESC, Board

fr.title: Nos entames qui ont coûté des levées
fr.help: **Nos entames qui ont perdu au moins un quart de levée en moyenne par rapport à la meilleure entame en simple mort (SD), vue de la main de l'entameur. DD_Lead_Cost montre le coût de l'entame sur la donne réelle.**

Opening_Lead_Summary.title: Opening Lead Accuracy: Me, Partner and Field
Opening_Lead_Summary.help: **Showing how often {player1_name} and {player2_name} found the best lead from their own hand (single dummy (SD)) and seeing all four hands (double dummy (DD)), and the tricks their leads gave up, next to the whole field's averages. Avg_Luck above 0 means the layouts helped our leads.**

prompts.sql: SELECT CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, COUNT(*) AS Leads, ROUND(AVG(CAST(SD_Lead_Is_Best AS INT)), 2) AS Pct_SD_Best, ROUND(AVG(SD_Lead_Cost), 2) AS Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(AVG(SD_Lead_Luck), 2) AS Avg_Luck, ROUND(AVG(CAST(Lead_Is_DD_Best AS INT)), 2) AS Pct_DD_Best, ROUND(AVG(DD_Lead_Cost), 2) AS Avg_DD_Lead_Cost, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(SD_Lead_Is_Best AS INT)), 2) FROM self) AS Field_Pct_SD_Best, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(SD_Lead_Cost), 2) FROM self) AS Field_Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(Lead_Is_DD_Best AS INT)), 2) FROM self) AS Field_Pct_DD_Best, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(DD_Lead_Cost), 2) FROM self) AS Field_Avg_DD_Lead_Cost FROM self WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY MIN(CASE WHEN Direction_OnLead = '{Player_Direction}' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END)

fr.title: Précision des entames : moi, mon partenaire et le champ
fr.help: **Fréquence à laquelle {player1_name} et {player2_name} ont trouvé la meilleure entame vue de leur main (simple mort (SD)) et en voyant les quatre mains (double mort (DD)), et levées perdues, comparées aux moyennes du champ. Avg_Luck supérieur à 0 : les donnes ont aidé nos entames.**

Opponents_Lead_Gifts.title: Tricks the Opponents' Leads Gave Us

fr.title: Levées offertes par l'entame adverse
fr.help: **Donnes que nous avons déclarées où l'entame nous a donné au moins une levée par rapport à la meilleure entame en double mort (DD).**

Lead_Rankings.title: Rank Leaders by Opening Lead Accuracy
Lead_Rankings.help: **Ranking players who made 4 or more opening leads by the tricks their leads gave up against the best lead from their own hand (single dummy (SD)), which does not reward guessing the layout. The double dummy (DD) columns compare with the best lead seeing all four hands.**

prompts.sql: WITH leads AS (SELECT CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_ID_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_ID_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_ID_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_ID_W END AS Leader_ID, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, SD_Lead_Is_Best, SD_Lead_Cost, Lead_Is_DD_Best, DD_Lead_Cost FROM self WHERE SD_Lead_Cost IS NOT NULL) SELECT Leader AS Name, COUNT(*) AS Leads, ROUND(AVG(SD_Lead_Cost), 2) AS Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(AVG(CAST(SD_Lead_Is_Best AS INT)), 2) AS Pct_SD_Best, ROUND(AVG(DD_Lead_Cost), 2) AS Avg_DD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(AVG(CAST(Lead_Is_DD_Best AS INT)), 2) AS Pct_DD_Best, Leader_ID FROM leads WHERE Leader_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Leader_ID, Leader HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY Avg_SD_Lead_Cost, Pct_SD_Best DESC, Leads DESC

Field_Leads_On_Our_Boards.title: Leads at Other Tables on Boards We Defended
Field_Leads_On_Our_Boards.help: **Showing the leads made at other tables against the same strain from the same seat on boards we defended. Leads chosen at fewer than 5% of those tables are left out unless they were ours.**

prompts.sql: WITH ours AS (SELECT Board, BidSuit, Direction_OnLead, Lead AS Our_Lead FROM self WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True), field AS (SELECT s.Board, s.BidSuit AS Strain, s.Direction_OnLead AS Leader_Seat, s.Lead, s.Lead = o.Our_Lead AS Our_Lead, COUNT(*) AS Tables, ROUND(COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.Board), 2) AS Share, BOOL_AND(s.Lead_Is_DD_Best) AS Is_DD_Best, ROUND(AVG(s.DD_Lead_Cost), 2) AS Avg_DD_Lead_Cost FROM self s JOIN ours o ON s.Board = o.Board AND s.BidSuit = o.BidSuit AND s.Direction_OnLead = o.Direction_OnLead WHERE s.DD_Lead_Cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.Board, s.BidSuit, s.Direction_OnLead, s.Lead, o.Our_Lead) SELECT * FROM field WHERE Our_Lead OR Share >= 0.05 ORDER BY Board, Tables DESC

fr.title: Entames des autres tables sur nos donnes en défense

Lead_Bad_Or_Unlucky.title: Bad Lead or Bad Luck?
Lead_Bad_Or_Unlucky.help: **Judging each opening lead {player1_name} and {player2_name} made. Costly choice: a poor lead from the leader's hand (single dummy (SD), at least a quarter of a trick on average) that also cost a trick on the actual layout (double dummy (DD)). Poor choice, layout forgave it: poor by SD but cost nothing here. Good choice, unlucky layout: the best SD lead, but it cost a trick on this layout. Luck above 0 means the layout helped the defence.**

prompts.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT Board, Contract, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, Lead, SD_Lead_Best_Card, ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS SD_Lead_Cost, DD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(SD_Lead_Luck::DOUBLE, 2) AS Luck, CASE WHEN ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.25 AND DD_Lead_Cost >= 1 THEN 'Costly choice' WHEN ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.25 THEN 'Poor choice, layout forgave it' WHEN DD_Lead_Cost >= 1 THEN 'Good choice, unlucky layout' ELSE 'Fine' END AS Verdict, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM self WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True AND SD_Lead_Cost IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM v ORDER BY CASE Verdict WHEN 'Costly choice' THEN 1 WHEN 'Poor choice, layout forgave it' THEN 2 WHEN 'Good choice, unlucky layout' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, SD_Lead_Cost DESC, Board

fr.title: Mauvaise entame ou malchance ?
fr.help: **Verdict sur chaque entame de {player1_name} et {player2_name}. Costly choice : entame faible vue de la main de l'entameur (simple mort (SD), au moins un quart de levée en moyenne) qui a aussi coûté une levée sur la donne réelle (double mort (DD)). Poor choice, layout forgave it : faible en SD mais sans coût ici. Good choice, unlucky layout : la meilleure entame SD, mais elle a coûté une levée sur cette donne. Luck supérieur à 0 : la donne a aidé la défense.**

Missed_Setting_Leads.title: Leads That Missed a Better Chance to Set
Missed_Setting_Leads.help: **Showing our opening leads where another card beat the contract at least 15 points more often over the sampled layouts (single dummy (SD)). Best_Set_Pct is the best chance any lead had; SD_Lead_Best_Card is the lead that takes the most tricks on average, usually the same card.**

prompts.sql: SELECT Board, Contract, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, Lead, ROUND(SD_Lead_Set_Pct::DOUBLE, 2) AS Set_Pct, ROUND(SD_Lead_Best_Set_Pct::DOUBLE, 2) AS Best_Set_Pct, ROUND(SD_Lead_Set_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS Set_Pct_Lost, SD_Lead_Best_Card, ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS SD_Lead_Cost, CASE WHEN Tricks >= BidLvl + 6 THEN 'Made' ELSE 'Set' END AS Result, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM self WHERE Boards_I_Played = True AND Boards_Opponent_Declared = True AND ROUND(SD_Lead_Set_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.15 ORDER BY SD_Lead_Set_Cost DESC, Board

fr.title: Entames qui ont manqué une meilleure chance de chute

Best_Set_Pct : la meilleure chance offerte par une entame ; SD_Lead_Best_Card : l'entame qui fait le plus de levées en moyenne, généralement la même carte.**

Opponents_Leads_SD.title: Opponents' Leads: Gift or Good Luck?
Opponents_Leads_SD.help: **Judging the opponents' opening leads on boards we declared. A lead that was poor from the leader's hand (single dummy (SD)) was a gift; one that was the best SD lead but still cost a trick on the actual layout (double dummy (DD)) was luck for us.**

prompts.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT Board, Contract, Declarer_Name, CASE Direction_OnLead WHEN 'N' THEN Player_Name_N WHEN 'E' THEN Player_Name_E WHEN 'S' THEN Player_Name_S WHEN 'W' THEN Player_Name_W END AS Leader, Lead, SD_Lead_Best_Card, ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) AS SD_Lead_Cost, DD_Lead_Cost, ROUND(SD_Lead_Luck::DOUBLE, 2) AS Luck, CASE WHEN ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.25 AND DD_Lead_Cost >= 1 THEN 'Costly choice' WHEN ROUND(SD_Lead_Cost::DOUBLE, 2) >= 0.25 THEN 'Poor choice, layout forgave it' WHEN DD_Lead_Cost >= 1 THEN 'Good choice, unlucky layout' ELSE 'Fine' END AS Verdict, Tricks, DD_Tricks, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM self WHERE Boards_We_Declared = True AND SD_Lead_Cost IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM v ORDER BY CASE Verdict WHEN 'Costly choice' THEN 1 WHEN 'Poor choice, layout forgave it' THEN 2 WHEN 'Good choice, unlucky layout' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, SD_Lead_Cost DESC, Board

fr.title: Entames adverses : cadeau ou chance ?
fr.help: **Verdict sur les entames adverses quand nous avons déclaré. Une entame faible vue de la main de l'entameur (simple mort (SD)) était un cadeau ; la meilleure entame SD qui a quand même coûté une levée sur la donne réelle (double mort (DD)) était de la chance pour nous.**

Declarer_Play_SuitC.title: Our Declarer Play vs SuitC
Declarer_Play_SuitC.help: **Showing boards we declared. Guess_Tricks is the tricks a declarer who cannot see the defenders' cards should expect to lose to guesses (SuitC, each suit on its own); vs_SuitC is tricks taken minus double dummy (DD) tricks plus Guess_Tricks, so 0 or more is par for a real declarer. Misplay means vs_SuitC is -0.5 or worse.**

prompts.sql: SELECT Board, Contract, Declarer_Name, Lead, Tricks, DD_Tricks, Tricks - DD_Tricks AS vs_DD, ROUND(SC_Guess_Declarer::DOUBLE, 2) AS Guess_Tricks, ROUND(DD_Tricks_Diff_SC::DOUBLE, 2) AS vs_SuitC, CASE WHEN Tricks > DD_Tricks THEN 'Gift from the defence' WHEN Tricks = DD_Tricks THEN 'Made DD tricks' WHEN DD_Tricks_Diff_SC > -0.5 THEN 'Lost to a guess' ELSE 'Misplay' END AS Verdict, ROUND(Pct_{Pair_Direction}, 4) AS Pct_{Pair_Direction} FROM self WHERE Boards_We_Declared = True AND SC_Guess_Declarer IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DD_Tricks_Diff_SC, Board

fr.title: Notre jeu de la carte face à SuitC
fr.help: **Donnes que nous avons déclarées. Guess_Tricks : levées qu'un déclarant qui ne voit pas les cartes adverses doit s'attendre à perdre sur des devinettes (SuitC, couleur par couleur) ; vs_SuitC : levées faites moins levées en double mort (DD) plus Guess_Tricks, donc 0 ou plus est le par pour un vrai déclarant. Misplay : vs_SuitC de -0,5 ou moins.**

Declarer_Rankings_SuitC.title: Rank Declarers by SuitC

prompts.sql: SELECT Declarer_Name AS Name, COUNT(*) AS Boards, ROUND(AVG(DD_Tricks_Diff_SC), 2) AS Avg_vs_SuitC, ROUND(AVG(Tricks - DD_Tricks), 2) AS Avg_vs_DD, ROUND(AVG(SC_Guess_Declarer), 2) AS Avg_Guess_Tricks, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN Declarer_Direction IN ('N', 'S') THEN Pct_NS ELSE Pct_EW END), 2) AS Avg_Pct, Declarer_ID AS Declarer FROM self WHERE SC_Guess_Declarer IS NOT NULL AND Declarer_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Declarer_ID, Declarer_Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4 ORDER BY Avg_vs_SuitC DESC

Overall_Rankings_Predictions.title: Overall Rankings Predictions
Overall_Rankings_Predictions.help: **Club rank and predicted club rank, FFBridge's published global rank and our predicted global rank, and the published and predicted session percentages. Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Pct, and the diffs are scratch, like the predictions. In a handicapped session, Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank, and Handicap_Global_Rank are FFBridge's figures with the IV bonus; they are blank when the session has no handicap. Each diff is actual minus predicted. A positive Pct_Diff means the pair scored above the prediction. A positive Rank_Diff means the pair finished lower than predicted, because a smaller rank is better. Club_Rank_Pred ranks predictions against the club's predictions; pairs with the same Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred share a place. Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred ranks the pair's prediction against the published percentages of the national field. Pct_Pred_SD is the prediction's standard deviation in percentage points, and Pct_Pred_Low to Pct_Pred_High is its 95% range; it narrows as more boards are played. Low_Confidence is true when either player had fewer than 20 earlier sessions (Min_Prior_Sessions is the smaller of the two counts), the pair had fewer than 5 earlier sessions together (Pair_Prior_Sessions), or the ratings are more than 30 days old. Ratings_Age_Days is filled only while the session is not yet in the Elo build: the predictions then use each player's latest rating, and Ratings_Age_Days is the age of the older of the pair's two ratings. Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast and Club_Rank_Forecast are the pre-game field forecast: the players' Elo only, no deals, as forecast before play; 50 is the average of the club's pairs in the same direction. Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred adds the deals and seats (the board model).**

prompts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(Section_Name, Pair_Number_NS, '-NS - ', Player_Name_N, ' - ', Player_Name_S) AS Pair, Club_Rank_NS AS Club_Rank, Club_Rank_Pred_NS AS Club_Rank_Pred, Club_Rank_Forecast_NS AS Club_Rank_Forecast, Global_Scratch_Rank_NS AS Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred_NS AS Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred, Rank_Diff_NS AS Rank_Diff, Global_Scratch_Pct_NS AS Global_Scratch_Pct, Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred_NS AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred, Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast_NS AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast, Pct_Diff_NS AS Pct_Diff, Handicap_Pct_NS AS Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank_NS AS Handicap_Club_Rank, Handicap_Global_Rank_NS AS Handicap_Global_Rank, Pct_Pred_SD_NS AS Pct_Pred_SD, Pct_Pred_Low_NS AS Pct_Pred_Low, Pct_Pred_High_NS AS Pct_Pred_High, Low_Confidence_NS AS Low_Confidence, Min_Prior_Sessions_NS AS Min_Prior_Sessions, Pair_Prior_Sessions_NS AS Pair_Prior_Sessions, Ratings_Age_Days_NS AS Ratings_Age_Days, Boards_NS AS Boards, 'NS' AS Orientation FROM self UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT(Section_Name, Pair_Number_EW, '-EW - ', Player_Name_E, ' - ', Player_Name_W) AS Pair, Club_Rank_EW AS Club_Rank, Club_Rank_Pred_EW AS Club_Rank_Pred, Club_Rank_Forecast_EW AS Club_Rank_Forecast, Global_Scratch_Rank_EW AS Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred_EW AS Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred, Rank_Diff_EW AS Rank_Diff, Global_Scratch_Pct_EW AS Global_Scratch_Pct, Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred_EW AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred, Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast_EW AS Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast, Pct_Diff_EW AS Pct_Diff, Handicap_Pct_EW AS Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank_EW AS Handicap_Club_Rank, Handicap_Global_Rank_EW AS Handicap_Global_Rank, Pct_Pred_SD_EW AS Pct_Pred_SD, Pct_Pred_Low_EW AS Pct_Pred_Low, Pct_Pred_High_EW AS Pct_Pred_High, Low_Confidence_EW AS Low_Confidence, Min_Prior_Sessions_EW AS Min_Prior_Sessions, Pair_Prior_Sessions_EW AS Pair_Prior_Sessions, Ratings_Age_Days_EW AS Ratings_Age_Days, Boards_EW AS Boards, 'EW' AS Orientation FROM self ORDER BY Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank

fr.title: Prédictions du classement général
fr.help: **Classement au club et classement au club prédit, classement mondial publié par la FFBridge et notre classement mondial prédit, et pourcentages de la séance publié et prédit. Club_Rank, Global_Scratch_Rank, Global_Scratch_Pct et les écarts sont en scratch, comme les prédictions. Dans une séance avec handicap, Handicap_Pct, Handicap_Club_Rank et Handicap_Global_Rank sont les résultats de la FFBridge avec le bonus IV ; ils sont vides quand la séance n'a pas de handicap. Chaque écart est le réel moins le prédit. Un Pct_Diff positif signifie que la paire a fait mieux que la prédiction. Un Rank_Diff positif signifie que la paire a fini moins bien classée que prédit, car un rang plus petit est meilleur. Club_Rank_Pred classe les prédictions parmi celles du club ; les paires de même Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred partagent une place. Global_Scratch_Rank_Pred classe la prédiction de la paire parmi les pourcentages publiés du classement national. Pct_Pred_SD est l'écart type de la prédiction en points de pourcentage, et Pct_Pred_Low à Pct_Pred_High son intervalle à 95 % ; il se resserre quand plus de donnes sont jouées. Low_Confidence est vrai quand l'un des joueurs avait moins de 20 séances antérieures (Min_Prior_Sessions est le plus petit des deux nombres), quand la paire avait moins de 5 séances antérieures ensemble (Pair_Prior_Sessions), ou quand les classements ont plus de 30 jours. Ratings_Age_Days n'est rempli que tant que la séance n'est pas encore dans le calcul Elo : les prédictions utilisent alors le dernier classement de chaque joueur, et Ratings_Age_Days est l'âge du plus ancien des deux classements de la paire. Global_Scratch_Pct_Forecast et Club_Rank_Forecast sont la prévision d'avant-match : uniquement l'Elo des joueurs, sans les donnes, comme avant la séance ; 50 est la moyenne des paires du club dans la même orientation. Global_Scratch_Pct_Pred ajoute les donnes et les places (le modèle par donne).**
